faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment is 20th August 2026. Candidates are advised to ensure their applications reach the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Senior Resident position, candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized university and an MS in ENT from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident post at PGIMER will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Senior Resident post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: The application for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post or as instructed.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Resident position is Ad-hoc.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the PGIMER located?
faq.answer: PGIMER is located in Chandigarh, with the pincode 160012.
